gloss: archive room; library stacks; book storage

definitions.gloss: archive room; library stacks; book storage
definitions.explanation: A room or building used for storing books, documents, or archives. In libraries, refers to the closed stacks where books are kept but not openly browsable.

examples.japanese: {書庫|しょこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。

⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{書庫|しょこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{係員|かかりいん}→係員：27111_kakariin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たの}んで→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: That book is in the stacks, so please ask a staff member.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書庫|しょこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧な⟦{古文書|こもんじょ}→古文書：15839_komonjo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}→保管：11442_hokan⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Precious historical documents are stored in the underground archive room.

notes:
USAGE:
{書庫|しょこ} can refer to the closed stacks in a library (where books are stored but not freely accessible to the public) or more generally to any room or building dedicated to storing books and documents.

FORMS:
⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (book, document) + {庫|こ} (storehouse).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書庫|しょこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the stacks
- ⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧{書庫|しょこ}: underground stacks
- {閉架式|へいかしき}{書庫|しょこ}: closed stacks (not open to browsing)
